scope: Saved JSON, including archives and ignored files. CLI exports included only for clean matching jobs in the explicitly supplied 50-job index; unlisted exports excluded. This is not full historical CLI coverage. Explicit disqualifications in the supplied own-jobs index override archived passing receipts. Lower elapsed is a numerical lead, not release eligibility or matched gain.

exclusions.reason: Swaps near-tied experts for ones on other GPUs so their weights are never read, which changes the model's output. Goes against the spirit of the challenge.

limitations: Completeness is limited to this50-job ownership index and saved supported receipts. Audit pass is not eligibility or authorization.
